newsitem.title: USA: Apache replaces $1 bln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Apache replaces $1 bln credit facility.

text.p: Apache Corp said Thursday that it replaced its existing $1 billion revolving credit facility with a global arrangement that provides the company with greater borrowing availability, increased tax efficiency and a lower overall interest rate.
The fresh arrangement consists of three separate bank facilities tied together by an intercreditor agreement, the independent oil and gas producer said in a statement.

The new deal adds Apache's oil and gas reserve values in Australia and Canada to those in the U.S. in determining the company's borrowing capacity. The facilities consist of $125 million of credit commitments each in Australia and Canada, and a $750 million credit commitment in the United States.
